An original young woman with long, dark brown
hair falls past her shoulders, standing outdoors with
her arms folded loosely. She wears a fitted hot pink
crop top with a one-shoulder neckline and a hot
pink satin mini skirt with a quilted cream panel at
one side. Her expression is relaxed and confident.
A gravel lot, a low building, and partly cloudy blue
sky in the background. Bright daylight. Palette of
hot pink, cream, and sky blue. Bold and energetic,
